evidence.FA3: Third exchange token behind BNB and LEO; Cronos DeFi TVL far below BNB Chain and no structural lock-in beyond the Crypto.com app.
evidence.FA4: Kris Marszalek has run Crypto.com since 2016; Cronos Labs shipped mainnet (Nov 2021) and Huygens v0.7 upgrade in 2022.
evidence.FB1: CRO is gas on Cronos and the staking asset on Crypto.org Chain; core use impossible without it.
evidence.FB2: DeFiLlama Cronos fees $287k in the 30d before cutoff, below the $1M bar.
evidence.FB3: Reward pool release rate and chain params are set by governance dominated by Crypto.com; 16.5% company-held supply has no public vesting.
evidence.FC1: Cronos EVM chain launched with a validator set approved by Cronos Labs/Crypto.com; not permissionless.
evidence.FC3: Cronos TVL fell through 2022 from its Q1 peak; Nov 2022 saw further outflows on FTX contagion fears.
evidence.FC4: Nov 13 2022: CEO disclosed 320k ETH sent to Gate.io by mistake on Oct 21; FTX contagion fears on the exchange are unresolved.
evidence.FC5: Fees $287k vs $293k prior 30d: flat, but not material (<$1M).
evidence.FC6: Only Cronos ID token (CROID) and analytics integrations in the Nov 9 2022 update; no dated mainnet upgrade verifiable pre-cutoff.

CRO.key_risk: Exchange-token contagion four days after FTX: Crypto.com's solvency and disclosure quality (320k ETH mis-send) are the price driver, not the chain.

evidence.FC5: No revenue data; VTHO burn immaterial.
evidence.FC6: PoA 2.0 finality (VIP-220) mainnet activation at block 13,815,000 on Nov 17 2022, announced Nov 8 2022.

VET.key_risk: Enterprise narrative has never converted into fee demand; the chain is foundation-controlled and has frozen balances before.

evidence.FC3: Sept 26 2022: storage providers up ~7x since Jan 2022, 20k users storing 50M objects, ~7k new developers.

FIL.key_risk: Structural sell pressure: PL/Foundation/SAFT vesting plus miner minting add tens of percent of circulating supply per year with near-zero paid demand.

QNT.key_risk: Token value rests on undisclosed licence flows; company holds ~17% unlocked and the 2022 rally priced CBDC hopes with no verifiable usage.
